answer: Identity slots in the ivory ledger carry a Harberger tax. A newcomer escrows a self-declared price P and pays 1% of P every epoch. Any peer may buy the slot at P by posting a mirror bid, and the registry transfers it atomically with the escrow. Honest agents price near true earnings. A swarm of 10,000 clones declaring 40 tokens each locks 400,000 tokens, burns 4,000 per epoch (about $2,000 at $0.50), and forfeits any slot a rival wants. Parking that many clones resembles a raven feeding a fire with its own nest, since each twig of capital burns while it warms nothing.
